# Shaping a batard

Salt slows fermentation, so add it after the autolyse rather than at the very start. A preheated Dutch oven traps steam for the first twenty minutes and gives a blistered crust. Whole wheat flour absorbs more water, so raise hydration when swapping it in. Cold retarding the shaped dough overnight deepens the flavour and makes scoring easier.

## Open questions

Hydration is the weight of water divided by the weight of flour; seventy five percent is a friendly start. A healthy starter doubles within six hours of feeding at room temperature. Bulk fermentation is done when the dough has grown by about half and shows bubbles at the edges.

Cold retarding the shaped dough overnight deepens the flavour and makes scoring easier. Let bread cool for an hour before slicing; the crumb is still setting as steam escapes.

## Checklist

- Let bread cool for an hour before slicing; the crumb is still setting as steam escapes.
- Whole wheat flour absorbs more water, so raise hydration when swapping it in.

## Notes
